authorityRequired: Separate exact owner approval under Authorisation 53 section 5; no permission is inferred from this file.
transport: Owner-operated Supabase SQL Editor only, in the already associated production project. No assistant Supabase connector call, automatic project discovery, login, credential sharing or alternative transport.

projectAssociation.ownerMustConfirm: The selected project matches the existing deployed Admin publicBackendConfig.url. Do not paste keys, tokens, credentials or private configuration. Stop on any mismatch.

limits.report: One dated owner-confirmed report; preserve query hashes and OK/HOLD status. No tokens, membership identities, product rows, inventory values, customer/order/cost data or function bodies.

assessment: Inspect only metadata for the exact 18 required columns and SELECT/ALL policies on public.components, public.inventory and public.admin_members. No business table rows are selected.
Compare actual column types and effective SELECT grants against the source adapter requirements; missing/unknown values are HOLD.

Compare actual RLS expressions, permissive/restrictive combinations and role applicability against reviewed source definitions. Hashes alone do not prove policy equivalence. No migration or policy repair is permitted.

Keep raw policy metadata private. If an expression contains a personal identifier, credential or private literal, redact it in the owner report and mark that policy UNKNOWN; do not publish it or infer semantic equivalence.

Owner supplies project association and report timestamp; those facts remain owner-confirmed. These queries do not independently establish project status, quota, reporting delay or browser JWT behaviour.

The following step remains separately bounded: finish the source adapter, then verify actual owner-controlled Auth/membership, exact list/detail reads, expiry/sign-out and failure handling without exporting credentials or modifying records.
This proposal excludes optional catalogue views, unrelated schema/writers, all mutations, catalogue/CMS generation and any production deployment.
supersedesForThisRelease: The broader unexecuted BACKEND_INSPECTION_CONTRACT.json proposal: optional view metadata and unrelated write grants are deferred. Required column grants and actual read-policy expressions are included here.
